_doc: Golden for the saoc-pagehero-mirror gates. Sources: NOS Design overnight critique 2026-10-25 (comms.md tail) and its final crop picks and four rulings relayed by the team lead (spec.md section 1). No native-cap exception, pink and yellow retired from every hero box.

If the band box is height-driven past 4608 device px, record as rulingNeeded (NOS Design extends y0 towards 450), never a clamp or a pass.

stubProbe.rule: the visible cover region of the derived cut, translated to original coordinates (offset = rect x0,y0), must not intersect the stub

cssBox.note: grid 1fr/1.1fr from 1100, 3/2 block below; the 2400x1750 cut is width-driven in the 3/2 block (1.5 > 1.3714) and height-driven in the grid while H*1.3714 > W; it covers a box up to 875 css high at @2 (1750/2) and 1200 css wide; A9 measures the real box. 1045-1099@2 is GATED (no clamp exception).

requiredWidth.formula: required = ceil(max(boxW, boxH * fileW / fileH) * DPR) in device px, the file being the served source or derived cut (its own aspect), checked against currentSrc decoded in a bare new Image(); NOS Design ruling 2026-10-25
requiredWidth.boxNote: post-mirror heroes: inner hero >=768 height floor 480 (copy may make it taller: the gate measures), stacked <768 is a vw x vw/2 band; home: stacked 2/1 band <=1023 (or <=1279 if the gate says so), else vw x 720 floor (984 at 2056; SAOC QA measured about 793 high at 1023 on main); PhotoBand floor 320 (minHeight on /about and /judging); ShowBand its grid box. heightDriven marks cover boxes whose required width exceeds boxW x DPR: those need sizes = max(100vw, boxH x aspect).

rows.name: PhotoBand /about (orchid-purple-band 700,750-5308,2050 @50% 45%)
rows.rulingNeededIf: the band box is taller than 4608/(2*3.545) = 650 css at @2 (433 at @3), or any height-driven box needs more than 4608 device px: record as rulingNeeded, NOS Design extends y0 towards 450; never a pass or a clamp

showBandRealHeight.note: NOS Design measured the ShowBand photo box at 602x762 at 1280@2 (copy column makes the row 762 high, not the 620 floor)
showBandRealHeight.risk: Measured: no row exceeds 2400. The tallest box is 762 css (plateau 1276-1372), required 2090; the cut covers a box up to 875 css high at @2. The tightest row is the stacked 1099@2 at 2198 (width-driven). The height is content-driven: a copy change can push it past 875, which A9 and A19 catch.
showBandRealHeight.yellowRowIsShowBand: the baseline "Yellow orchid on t.." row (602x762 at 1280) IS the home and /events ShowBand photo; yellow retires and it becomes orchid-dark-showband (2400x1542, 1.556:1). No sizes is tuned for yellow.
showBandRealHeight.contentDriven: the row height is the copy column height plus 180 css of padding (min 620), so it is content-driven: a future copy change, a longer title or a narrower column can push the box past 771 css and the required width past 2400. A9 and A19 catch it as a failure; nothing clamps.

measured.build: production build of origin/main ee2e9941 (CI env, placeholder preview on, beta wall up), Chromium, deviceScaleFactor 2, viewport height 900, read-only
measured.stackedRange: 768-1099: H = vw/1.5 exactly (the 3/2 block); box aspect 1.5 > file 1.3714, so WIDTH-driven: required = 2 x vw, 1536 at 768 to 2198 at 1099; sizes 100vw below 1100

sweep14.note: the 14 SAOC routes this gate covers for hero, band and PhotoBand served width (SAOC image-sweep baseline, 2026-10-25); per-route rows are finalised from NOS Design/SAOC table when it arrives
sweep14.source: NOS Design HM-1 served-width baseline, comms.md 2026-10-25 (61 rows, image-sweep.js). The rows are the list of things to cover, not expected values: sim rows are not measurements, the gate measures at a real DPR (390@3 with deviceScaleFactor 3).

sweep.rule: every raster img wider than 80 and taller than 60 CSS px on each route, not svg: served naturalWidth >= ceil(max(boxW, boxH x aspect) x DPR) when object-fit is cover, else ceil(boxW x DPR)
